description: After expiry: finds the first Chainlink round at or after expiry, encodes the proof as abi.encode(uint80 roundId) and picks the path that applies now: settle(proof) if that round landed within expiry + maxSettleLag; otherwise guardianSettle(proof) for the guardian Safe, or settleBackstop(proof) for anyone from expiry + maxSettleLag + 7 days. Refused before expiry, once settled, and until the round has printed. Returns UNSIGNED transaction data (to, data, value, gas) for the user's own wallet; simulated against the latest block first and refused if it would revert. Never signs or sends.

from.description: Optional: the address that will send it, used as the simulated sender. Ignored for guardianSettle, which is simulated from the guardian Safe.

market.description: Market address (0x...) or symbol, e.g. NO-NVDA

name: prepare_settle
title: Prepare settle
